rule: A row pins BYTES to a TABLE. The table must be reproduced by an independent tool from a pinned source/patch (domain_source) and, where a device or host was available, measured by a uinput ordinal probe against the exact library (measured_by). CFW name, device name and GUID appear as evidence only; they never select a row.
